# Student register foundations

Open StudyLab.csproj in Visual Studio with .NET 10. Build, then Start Without Debugging. Alternatively run dotnet run in this folder.

Expected output:

```text
Lefa: 65
Pass
Mark: 65
Mark: 40
Mark: 80
Pass
Student: Lefa, result: Pass
```

Change mark to 45 and predict the changed lines. The marks list is separate, so its three values stay unchanged. This is a console project, not an API. Keep it in its own folder.
